sections.heading: Equipping an Essence
sections.body: Absorbing an Essence unlocks it, but it does not help in combat until it is placed in an active loadout.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Select Equip Essence to add the Goblin's Essence to your draft, then save the loadout to apply your changes. Unsaved loadout changes are highlighted on the Save button.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: After this step, you receive starter armor. The Essence and armor together prepare you for your first Lumo Ruins expedition.
